visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a modern, dark-toned kitchen where a shirtless, highly muscular man is seen from the back, flexing his latissimus dorsi and back muscles. He wears navy patterned pajama pants. A young girl with dark hair and a white t-shirt runs playfully around his legs in the foreground. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the muscle definition. (2) The man turns to face the camera, showcasing his abdominal and pectoral muscles with a wide smile and high energy. The girl continues to move excitedly near him, eventually standing still to look at him. A white '2025' text overlay appears at the top center. The background includes kitchen essentials like a kettle and jars on the countertop. (3) The man performs various bodybuilding poses, transitioning from front double biceps to side chest and most muscular. The girl mimics his movements, raising her arms in a similar flexing gesture while laughing. Several text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear sequentially at the bottom, discussing his daily routine and the emotional meaning of Father's Day. (4) The video cuts to a clip from three years prior, indicated by a '2022' text overlay. The man is in the same kitchen setting, appearing slightly less bulky but still very fit. His daughter is a much smaller toddler, wearing striped pajamas, standing beside him as he flexes for the camera. The camera remains static throughout the sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with raw ambient sounds of a kitchen environment. A man's deep, hearty laughter is prominent, immediately followed by the high-pitched, joyful giggling and playful, excited squeals of a young child. There is no background music during this short intro, focusing on the intimate family interaction. (2) An upbeat acoustic-pop song abruptly fades in. It features a bright, jangly acoustic guitar strumming a rhythmic pattern at approximately 115 BPM. A male vocalist begins singing in English with a friendly, warm, and melodic tone. The child's giggling remains audible as a low-level background layer under the music. (3) The musical arrangement swells with the addition of steady percussion and light synthesizer pads as it enters a chorus section. The vocals become more emphatic, repeating 'My daughter, my everything'. The mix is professionally mastered with high spectral clarity and balanced dynamics, drowning out the earlier room tone. (4) The song continues with consistent energy through the transition to an older recording. The acoustic guitar and vocals remain the primary drivers of the soundscape. There are no transient SFX or sudden production cuts, creating a smooth, linear auditory experience that supports the sentimental theme of the visual montage.
